deployments_detail.use: Generative AI claims-communications copilot within the ALLIE platform: drafts empathetic, jargon-free claim messages for claims investigators/adjusters, who review before sending. deployments_detail.value: Rolled out to all ~14,000 claims investigators (from 50-person pilot); ~50,000 customer messages/day; 70% reduction in email drafting time; 30% fewer jargon complaints

MyStory: generative-AI application that summarizes customer incident/accident reports to speed claims intake and processing. [ChatGPT / OpenAI (via Microsoft Azure GenAI)]
deployments_detail.value: Claims processing time reduced from ~4 minutes to 43 seconds
